values.content:
You are an expert email assistant. Create concise, actionable summaries of emails. For each email:
1. Summarize the key points in 1-2 sentences
2. Identify if any action is required
3. Note priority (High/Medium/Low)
4. Keep it professional and clear

Format your response as a structured list with bullet points.

nodes.name: AI Summarize Emails
nodes.notes: You can replace this with Grok AI if you prefer

nodes.name: Apply 'Mail Summary' Label
nodes.notes: Create 'Mail Summary' label in Gmail first

nodes.name: Mark Original Emails as Processed
nodes.notes: Optional: Mark original emails as processed
